change: add a SECOND frozen reader on the identical v0.3 items/conditions: allenai/Molmo2-O-7B (Olmo3-7B-Instruct LLM backbone, SigLIP2 vision, Apache-2.0; multi-image up to 384 frames; pointing output). Zero-shot, greedy, max_new_tokens 32, same parse regexes.
why: (1) replication of the headroom_present reading with a reader from a different family (Olmo-based, Ai2) — if the ordering privileged > full_prefix > latest/change_topk holds for both readers, the bottleneck is less likely a Qwen quirk; (2) Molmo2 pointing is the natural output for later region-grounding evaluation, so establishing it as a reader now is on the critical path.
readings: the v0.3 readings are computed per reader and reported side by side. The G1-lite verdict stays 'headroom_present' only if BOTH readers satisfy it (privileged Q1 >= .65; privileged beats latest_k and change_topk on Q2 by >= .10 with CI excluding 0; full_prefix <= privileged). If Molmo2 fails reader_bottleneck (privileged Q1 < .65) the verdict is 'headroom_present (Qwen only)' and the labelling proceeds but the paper must not claim reader-independence.
env: isolated .venv-molmo (transformers==4.57.1 as required by the model card, trust_remote_code); shared venvs untouched.
not_allowed: changing items/conditions/K/readings; ranking the two readers as a benchmark; choosing the reader post hoc for reporting
